title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature will allow yantraverse to parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling developers to handle complex request data and improving overall framework usability. It will provide a robust way to handle different content types and ensure accurate data extraction. This feature is essential for building robust and scalable applications
acceptance: Request body parsing should work correctly for JSON and URL-encoded data, and error handling should be implemented for invalid content types
reason: This feature is critical for improving the framework's usability and supporting a wide range of application development use cases
